name: Daily Puzzle
hook: One new puzzle a day. Beat your friends’ time.
how: Everyone in the world gets the same picture puzzle each day. Fill the squares so every row and column matches its numbers, and a little picture appears. Your time goes on today's board, and your streak grows every day you solve it.
controls: Tap or drag to fill squares; switch to ✕ Mark (or right-click) to mark empty ones
uses: One board per day: today's fastest solves.
See everyone in the room solving today's puzzle, live.
The owner can change the puzzle size or show an event banner on a schedule, with no new deploy.
Your streak is kept in your player save.
Ghost solvers race you when the room is quiet.
ideas: Switch to a five-letter word puzzle
